events.subtitle: featuring Edward Simon, Scott Colley & Brian Blade

priority_review.rationale: Three Visitors brings Edward Simon, Scott Colley and Brian Blade into a small-room working trio whose interaction merits protecting the night. The multi-date Tokyo engagement keeps each performance at S rather than S+.

events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Three Visitors featuring Edward Simon, Scott Colley and Brian Blade on December 13-14, 2026. December 13 has 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets; December 14 has 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets. The venue describes the trio as a project formed by three important figures in contemporary jazz and centers the engagement on their 2024 GroundUP Music album Three Visitors. Web reservations are scheduled to open September 8 for JAM SESSION members and September 14 for general booking.

en.why_it_matters: Three Visitors is the interaction itself: Edward Simon's compositional piano language, Scott Colley's unusually structural bass playing and Brian Blade's instantly recognizable sense of pulse and dynamics. In a small Tokyo room, there is no concept or tribute framing to hide behind; the reason to go is to hear three elite improvisers who have worked together in multiple settings turn a working trio into a conversation with its own identity.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one of the four COTTON CLUB sets and cross Tokyo specifically for it if the trip overlaps December 13-14. Together with the Blue Note Tokyo date the following night, this becomes a very strong music-trip anchor, but the three-date Tokyo run keeps it below S+ and it does not by itself justify a transpacific trip.

es.why_it_matters: Three Visitors es la interacción misma: el lenguaje compositivo al piano de Edward Simon, el bajo extraordinariamente estructural de Scott Colley y el sentido de pulso y dinámica inmediatamente reconocible de Brian Blade. En una sala pequeña de Tokio no hay concepto ni homenaje detrás del cual esconderse; la razón para ir es escuchar a tres improvisadores de primer nivel, con una larga historia de cruces entre ellos, convertir un trío de trabajo en una conversación con identidad propia.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale proteger uno de los cuatro sets de COTTON CLUB y cruzar Tokio específicamente por él si el viaje coincide con el 13-14 de diciembre. Sumado a Blue Note Tokyo la noche siguiente, forma un ancla muy fuerte para un viaje musical, pero las tres fechas en Tokio lo mantienen debajo de S+ y por sí solo no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

en.why_it_matters: Three Visitors puts three unusually individual improvisational voices into a format where interaction is the whole point: Edward Simon's compositional piano, Scott Colley's structural and highly responsive bass language, and Brian Blade's singular control of pulse, color and dynamics. Blue Note Tokyo is a room where the trio's small changes of time, density and space should matter more than spectacle.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one of the two Blue Note Tokyo sets if you are in the city; paired with the two preceding COTTON CLUB nights, it is a particularly strong three-night Tokyo jazz run. It remains below S+ because this is a multi-date working-trio visit rather than a singular farewell, premiere or one-off historical event.

es.why_it_matters: Three Visitors pone tres voces de improvisación extraordinariamente individuales en un formato donde la interacción es todo: el piano compositivo de Edward Simon, el lenguaje estructural y reactivo del bajo de Scott Colley y el control singular de pulso, color y dinámica de Brian Blade. Blue Note Tokyo es una sala donde los pequeños cambios de tiempo, densidad y espacio del trío pueden importar más que el espectáculo.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale proteger uno de los dos sets de Blue Note Tokyo si estás en la ciudad; junto con las dos noches previas en COTTON CLUB, forma una corrida de tres noches particularmente fuerte para un viaje jazzístico en Tokio. Se queda debajo de S+ porque es una visita de varias fechas de un trío activo, no una despedida, estreno o acontecimiento histórico único.
